Barbara Newhall Follett, The House Without Windows.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/barbara-newhall-follett/the-house-without-windows

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Barbara Newhall Follett, the author, died 1939.
- Roy Wilson Follett, the writer of added commentary, died 1963.

First publication of the text used: 1927 (SE colophon: 'The House Without Windows was published in 1927 by Barbara Newhall Follett.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in New York in 1927, before 1931, so the US rule settles the country of origin too. The edition's rights statement (quoted below) also places the text in the US public domain.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in New York by Alfred A. Knopf in 1927 (Wikipedia, The House Without Windows: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_House_Without_Windows). Because the first publication was in the United States before 1931, the US rule settles the origin too, whatever the death years.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
